concerns.text: The plan cites the VAERS parquet URL `https://huggingface.co/datasets/chrisvoncsefalvay/vaers-outcomes/resolve/main/data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet`, which appears to be a test subset rather than the full 2020‑2023 VAERS dataset required for robust disproportionality analysis. Using this limited file may not contain the necessary volume or the full range of vaccine types and SOC codes, jeopardizing the validity of the statistical results.
